title: Open Armor - Social
description: Replaces the visuals of armor sets in game with one that shows most of your skin contents at the expense of making armor look ridiculous
body:
## _Featuring_
- New textures of armor and everything related to armor.
- Text replacements for ```English [US/UK] & Russian/Русский & Japanese/日本語)```
-  Want something similar but with a less ridiculous feel to it? Check out [Open Armor - Fantasy](https://modrinth.com/project/hots-open-armor-fantasy)!
